scope.description: Local vote log-freshness protection after a successful vote-term write followed by one reported, no-overwrite candidate-key Set failure. Stable voter configuration; candidate request fields come from its actual local log.
assumptions: Successful StableStore writes persist and later reads return their values.
One candidate-key Set returns an error without changing the previous candidate; other storage operations succeed.
Non-Byzantine messages, unchanged IDs and addresses, no log rollback; selected RPC losses and storage-preserving restarts are permitted.
No earlier completed vote persistence for the stale candidate in the measured requested term.
excluded: Behavior of a backend whose failed write corrupts data or rolls back earlier successful writes.
Proof that a particular production StableStore backend exhibits this failure.
Execution of later conflicting log commitment, state-machine divergence or client data loss.
General requirement to recheck every legitimate duplicate vote.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: skipStartup suppresses autonomous background loops. The driver runs actual follower timeout and electSelf, drains all produced votes, and performs the same majority state transition as runCandidate; it does not implement a substitute vote handler.

Leader setup/no-op dispatch and actual replicateTo drive log prefix; driver executes source leaderLoop commit setters after actual commitment reaches the no-op. FSM consumption and independent timer races are not exercised.
Transport directly dispatches source processRPC. Exactly b-to-v term-4 and b-to-a term-5 RequestVote calls return scheduled loss; AppendEntries deliveries execute the real handler.
StableStore wrapper returns one candidate-key error before mutation; successful writes and restart state use the original InmemStore. The fault is injected only in one branch.
No later log overwrite or client endpoint is constructed or claimed; observing election counts is diagnostic, not a separate property.

plan_uncertainties: The error-returning candidate write is a controlled StableStore substitute; no concrete production backend failure is exercised.
Main-loop election-result and commit-notification scheduling is explicit; autonomous timer races and FSM endpoints are outside the local handler claim.
